data.title: Logbook order for vehicle BF-MU 412
data.summary: Kreis Beispielförde (driver's licence and vehicle department) ordered a logbook requirement (Fahrtenbuchauflage) under § 31a StVZO for vehicle BF-MU 412 for six months. The order is dated 29 September 2026 and follows a traffic offence on 14 July 2026 whose driver could not be identified.
data.explanation: The authority says a traffic offence was committed with your registered vehicle and the driver could not be identified. It therefore orders you to keep a logbook (Fahrtenbuch) for this vehicle for six months. The duty starts once the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft). You may decide to object (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person to the office; the app shows the deadline. If you do not object in time, the order becomes final. Legal advice may be useful if you want to contest it.

items.title: Object to logbook order

date.text: binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or on record with Kreis Beispielförde.
items.consequence: Otherwise the order becomes final and the logbook duty begins.
